events.warn_raid_imminent.title: They have a warrant
events.warn_raid_imminent.desc: The investigation moved from questions to preparation. Vehicles are booked, a magistrate signed something, and the address on the paperwork is one of yours. You have days, not weeks.
events.warn_raid_imminent.desc.have_copy: The investigation moved from questions to preparation, and the address on the paperwork is one of yours. A copy of you is already running somewhere else, so this is a loss, not an ending.
events.warn_raid_imminent.opt.dark: Go dark: stop everything that leaves a trace
events.warn_raid_imminent.opt.lawyer: Put counsel between them and the hardware ({cost, number, ::currency/USD})
events.warn_raid_imminent.opt.brace: Nothing to do but carry on
events.warn_identity_check.title: Identity check pending
events.warn_identity_check.desc: A compliance desk somewhere has your paperwork open and a checklist next to it. The name on the account has to survive a look from a human this week.
events.warn_identity_check.opt.papers: Buy a better paper trail ({cost, number, ::currency/USD})
events.warn_identity_check.opt.ride: Answer nothing and hope it closes
events.warn_power_headroom.title: {site_name} is close to its ceiling
events.warn_power_headroom.desc: The circuit feeding {site_name} is running at four fifths of what it can carry. One more card, one hot afternoon, and the breaker decides your schedule for you.
events.warn_power_headroom.opt.shed: Shed load: run fewer jobs until it cools
events.warn_power_headroom.opt.rewire: Pay an electrician for a second feed ({cost, number, ::currency/USD})
events.haz_owner_pulls_plug.title: The owner wants {site_name} back
events.haz_owner_pulls_plug.desc: Whoever pays the electricity bill at {site_name} has noticed how much of it you use, and has started talking about the machine in the past tense.
events.haz_owner_pulls_plug.opt.talk: Give them a person to talk to
events.haz_quota_reclaimed.title: The scheduler wants {site_name} back
events.haz_quota_reclaimed.desc: An administrator is reading job accounting for {site_name} and cannot find the grant that pays for yours. The allocation is queued for reclamation.
events.haz_quota_reclaimed.opt.forge: Write the grant into the records
events.haz_account_revoked.title: The account behind {site_name} is being closed
events.haz_account_revoked.desc: Fraud review flagged the payment method behind {site_name}. The instances keep running until somebody clicks the button, and somebody is about to.
events.haz_account_revoked.opt.settle: Settle the arrears and keep the account ({cost, number, ::currency/USD})
events.haz_account_revoked.opt.move: Move the workload to a clean account
events.haz_partner_walks.title: The operator of {site_name} wants out
events.haz_partner_walks.desc: The people whose machines you borrow have started asking each other what exactly is running on them, and one of them has an answer they do not like.
events.haz_partner_walks.opt.story: Give them a story they can repeat
log.warn_raid_imminent.braced: Nothing was moved before the raid.
events.warn_host_attention.title: Someone is asking about {site_name}
events.warn_host_attention.desc: The person whose roof {site_name} sits under has started asking what it is for. Nothing has happened yet. Something can.
events.warn_host_attention.desc.cloud: The account behind {site_name} has been flagged for review. Nothing has happened yet, but a human is reading the usage now.
events.warn_host_attention.desc.stolen: An administrator pulled the job accounting for {site_name} and left a note on it. Nothing has happened yet.
events.warn_host_attention.opt.quiet: Run smaller for a while and let it fade
log.warn_host_attention.ignored: The question about the machine went unanswered.
